title: Batch normalization forward and backward
summary: Training and inference forward passes with running statistics, and the full backward pass for x, gamma and beta.

mutants.backward_ignores_batch_stats: Returns grad_output * gamma / std for dx and forgets that x also moves the batch mean and variance.
mutants.eps_outside_sqrt: Divides by sqrt(var) + eps, not by sqrt(var + eps).
mutants.in_place_running_mean: Updates running_mean in place, so the caller's array changes.
mutants.inference_uses_batch_stats: Uses the batch mean and variance in inference mode, not the running statistics.
mutants.momentum_swapped: Gives the old running value the weight momentum and the batch value the weight 1 - momentum.
mutants.unbiased_variance: Uses the unbiased variance with N - 1, not the biased variance with N.
